name: Naamah
abilities: Song of Seduction — melody charms enemy, makes them walk toward Naamah for 2s
passives: Blood Contract: Malvera gains Debtfire when sustain play banks survival value through terrain mastery and converts it into recovery on contract-scorched court ground. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a debt, clause, and dominion law rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Infernal Dominion.
lore: Naamah, Velvet Ash Enchantress, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Infernal Dominion. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: infernal enchantress, forbidden song, ash-velvet bargain healing, pleasure turned binding contract. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses infernal enchantress, forbidden song, ash-velvet bargain healing, pleasure turned binding contract; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Infernal Dominion canon.
visualDescription: Naamah manifests as infernal enchantress, forbidden song, ash-velvet bargain healing, pleasure turned binding contract from Infernal Dominion: beautiful seductive feminine face, soft eyes hiding knives, full mouth, delicate chin, courtly danger; curvy graceful feminine enchantress build, elegant shoulders, defined waist and hips, languid commanding posture; signature silhouette: harp-chain arc, velvet train, small horns, fan-and-seal court outline. Weapon: song-chain harp blade and blood-wax seal fan. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Malvera — Black-Iron Clause Cut Restore
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Infernal Dominion source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Contract Debt gain when used from black-iron contract ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchy, ash velvet, hellfire clauses.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Blood-Wax Contract Technique — Covenant
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to restores through faction ritual, cleanses pressure, and rewards holding sacred ground without becoming a passive healer. Builds Contract Debt only when the Avatar uses black-iron contract ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Malvera: Infernal Debt Verdict Renewal Rite
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Contract Debt to impose a two-round rule from Infernal Dominion: restores through faction ritual, cleanses pressure, and rewards holding sacred ground without becoming a passive healer. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Hell-Crown Dominion Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Contract Debt, transform nearby terrain into black-iron contract ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Malvera Restorer Goetic Chain-Crown Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through black-iron contract ground. Visual: black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchy, ash velvet, hellfire clauses.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Malvera Volcanic Glass Debtor Plate
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Infernal Dominion source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the Avatar followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Malvera Blood-Wax Infernal Ledger Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Contract Debt and unlocks a mastery branch for Infernal Clause Step, Chain-Lien Reversal, and Collect the Soul Clause. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: win attrition and cleanse hazard pressure
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Malvera's Blood Contract: a solo mechanic where Debtfire grows through contract-scorched court ground, reaction-window mastery, and sustain decisions that bank survival value through terrain mastery and convert it into recovery. Payoff: survive long missions without ally healing or generic lifesteal. Counterplay: anti-heal pressure and hazard denial starve recovery; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: anti-heal pressure and hazard denial starve recovery
